(Corrupted Commander Theme)|250px|center|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Outpost 16''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the first night of the [[Null & Void Event]]. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there are in the match. The rewards received were based on how many waves were survived and if the match was won. This map had two difficulties, Easy and Hard. Cash was only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This meant that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. Health of enemies in this mode scaled with player count and difficulty. *In Easy, the increase was 5% in duo, 20% in trio and 40% in quad. *In Hard, the increase was 30% in duo, 60% in trio and 70% in quad. This map had the [[Path Spawn Even]] modifier, which was an indicator of each enemy only appearing on one path. In the hard difficulty, various curses could also be applied, [[Skills]] became disabled and the [[Farm]]'s income was disabled. Base health was set to 100. The final boss of the map was the [[Null Commander]]. ==Design & Path== '''Outpost 16''' was a research and development headquarters located at the outskirts of [[Cyber City]]. It was placed specifically on the side of a cliff, overlooking the city. It was a mostly orange colored facility that housed multiple futuristic buildings, containers and lamps. Near the middle of the map, around 50 [[God Cube]] fragments could be seen laying on a platform, which later on began to merge. The outpost was accessed through a road which lead to [[Cyber City]]. It ended at a parking lot at '''Outpost 16'''. The map itself went through multiple changes as the waves progress. The [[God Cube]] fragments initially laid on the floor and did not start to merge until later. The map started out with an orange sky, which became darker after the first cutscene. The whole outpost also broke apart as waves go on, with some buildings getting completely destroyed. Three paths started at separate portals, converging very early on and taking a few 90-degree turns before ending at a gate leading to the inside of the research base. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Outpost 16}} ==Curses== In the Hard difficulty, every fifth wave a curse was applied to the match. Curses were modifiers which came with both upsides and downsides. They lasted the entire match and, majority of the time, did not boost the rewards the match gave out. The following curses could be applied: *[[Justice]], upon reaching 25% of the base health, every tower received a 10% [[Damage Buff]]. *[[The Fool]], set the base health to 1 but also increased all wave bonuses by 10%. *[[The Tower]], debuffs like stuns now lasted 50% longer when applied to towers, but debuffs like burn now lasted 25% longer when applied to enemies. Additionally, ''Call to Arms'' duration was also extended by 10%. *[[The Moon]], made all enemies [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] but also gave every tower a 10% [[Range Buff]]. *[[The Star]], applied a 5% [[Range Debuff]] and 5% [[Firerate Debuff]] (~5.26% increase) to towers, but increased every player's total tower placement limit by 5. *[[The Sun]], enemies now all spawned with the [[Stun Immunity]], [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Burn Immunity]], but towers now had all three detections. *[[The Chariot]], all towers received a 10% [[Firerate Debuff]] (~11.11% increase), which was replaced with a 10% [[Firerate Buff]] and 10% [[Damage Buff]] on the final wave. *[[Temperance]], [[Mutation]] was applied which boosted the [[Shield Health]] of enemies by 5% of their base health, but gave all towers stun immunity and boosted rewards by 20%. *[[Death]], all enemies were now [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]], but rewards were increased by 20%. ==Preset Loadouts== Each player was allowed to pick from one of three preset loadouts in the Easy difficulty. Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable. {{PresetLoadout |Name = Tactician |Description = A well-rounded and adaptable loadout. |Icon1 = DefaultMilitantIG.png |SlotLink1 = Militant |Icon2 = DefaultFreezerIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = Freezer |Icon3 = HW24DefaultSlasherIconIG.png |SlotLink3 = Slasher |Icon4 = May17CommanderIconIG.png |SlotLink4 = Commander |Icon5 = DefaultMilitaryBaseIconNewIG.png |SlotLink5 = Military Base }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Experimental |Description = A loadout that brings a variety of towers that excel in specific situations. |Icon1 = DefaultTrapperIconIG.png |SlotLink1 = Trapper |Icon2 = DefaultHarvesterIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = Harvester |Icon3 = DefaultMedicIconIGAug25.png |SlotLink3 = Medic |Icon4 = MinigunnerIconIV.png |SlotLink4 = Minigunner |Icon5 = DefaultJesterIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = Jester }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Crowd Control |Description = A defensive class that focuses on applying debuffs and AOE damage. |Icon1 = DefaultPyromancerIconIG.png |SlotLink1 = Pyromancer |Icon2 = DefaultHallowPunkIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = Hallow Punk |Icon3 = DefaultAcePilotIconIGJ24.png |SlotLink3 = Ace Pilot |Icon4 = DefaultRocketeerIconIGJan25.png |SlotLink4 = Rocketeer |Icon5 = DefaultElectroshockerIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = Electroshoker }} ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- ! colspan="2" |Easy |- |({{Coins|200}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.2 |({{Exp|45}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|10}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.2 |- ! colspan="2" |Hard |- |({{Coins|500}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.2 |({{Exp|130}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|30}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.2 |} Triumphing '''Outpost 16''' could give out an additional reward, which could be a crate, consumable or ticket. They were meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this did not always happen. These items in the Easy difficulty were: *{{Color|Common}} (55%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (2-4) **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (2-3) **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (2-3) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **[[Turkey Leg]] (2-4) **[[Pumpkin Bomb]] (2-4) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (35%) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (2-4) *{{Color|Rare}} (10%) **[[Unholy Storm]] (2-3) **[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] (2-3) **[[High Grade Crate]] In the Hard difficulty, these were: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (2-4) **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (2-3) **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (2-3) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **[[Turkey Leg]] (2-4) **[[Pumpkin Bomb]] (2-4) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (2-3) *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Unholy Storm]] (2-3) **[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] (2-3) **[[High Grade Crate]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There were also a few [[badges]] and achievements which could be obtained when playing this map. These are: {{Badge |title = Night I Easy |ID = Null Night I Easy |image = Null&VoidNight1.png |obtainable = No |description = Commander.. is that you?!? Earned by defeating the Null Commander on ‘Easy’ in the Null & Void Event. }} {{Badge |title = Defender |description = Triumph on Night 1 Easy Mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Coins|150}}, 1x {{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}}, 1x {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} }} {{Badge |title = Night I |ID = Null Night I |image = Null&VoidNightIHard.png |obtainable = No |description = Commander.. is that you?!? Earned by defeating the Null Commander on ‘Hard’ in the Null & Void Event.
Complete all 3 nights on ‘Hard’ to unlock the event tower. }} {{Badge |title = Breached |description = Triumph on Night 1 Hard Mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Coins|300}}, 2x {{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}}, 2x {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}}, 1x [[Unholy Storm]] }} ==Wave Structure== '''Outpost 16''' had a few wave bonuses which changed based on the difficulty and wave. Between Wave 1 and 14 in Easy, it was: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.2 Between Wave 15 and 19 in Easy, it was: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.225 Between Wave 1 and 14 in Hard, it was: :{{Money|600}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.225 Between Wave 15 and 19 in Hard, it was: :{{Money|600}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|100}})^1.25 In both difficulties, Wave 20 gave {{Money|15,000}}. Depending on player count, the wave bonus was reduced using multipliers. These multipliers were: {| class="wikitable pad-10 align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |5% |10% |- |Trio |5% |15% |- |Quad |10% (Easy)
5% (Hard) |40% (Easy)
20% (Hard) |} The wave clear bonus appeared when every enemy from that wave was killed and no damage was dealt to the base health. It was 25% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it was 20%. Waves could not be skipped in '''Outpost 16'''. The waves in '''Outpost 16''' mode followed these timings: {| class="wikitable pad-10 align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer |- |1-4 |1:00 |- |5-13 |1:15 |- |14-19 |1:30 |- |20 |∞ |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *Due to the gamemode not having many waves, cheaper towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Rocketeer]] should be used. **The [[Golden Scout]] is especially effective, as it does very high DPS for a cheap price while also having lead detection, essentially being able to solo the whole mode by itself. *Support towers like the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] are recommended to beat the mode. **The [[Medic]] will be less useful, since the [[Null Freezer]] can freeze your towers, bypassing its shield. *The [[Farm]] should not be used on this map in the Hard difficulty, as its income generation is disabled there. **This, however, does not apply to the Easy difficulty. *This map contains curses, which apply a modifier that comes with downsides and upsides. **Generally, the curses chosen should be appropriate for the player's current loadouts. For example, [[The Moon]] should not be chosen if you lack hidden detection. ***You may be able to pick [[The Sun]] to give your towers all detections first, then pick [[The Moon]] later. **[[The Fool]] is quite effective as it can boost the wave bonuses by 10% for the minor downside of reducing base health to 1. As most mid to late-game waves will generally result in death when leaking enemies, the downside is practically nonexistent. ***It can also synergize with [[Justice]], but only if [[Justice]] was picked first. If picked first, [[The Fool]] reducing base health will qualify as reaching 25% of the base health, though applying [[The Fool]] first then [[Justice]] will instead lock you out of ever getting its [[Damage Buff]]. **[[Justice]] is a safe pick, as at worst it has literally no impact on the match and at best, makes it easier. **[[The Tower]] can be useful if you rely a lot on towers that apply debuffs, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Jester]], [[Toxic Gunner]] or [[Swarmer]]. Otherwise, this should not be picked as it has the downside of increased enemy debuff duration. **[[The Moon]] is a great pick if every tower brought has hidden detection or [[The Sun]] is active, as that curse's upside completely negates [[The Moon]]'s downside. **[[The Sun]] is a good pick in cases where you do not use any stun, freeze or burn towers, as it gives all towers every detection. **[[The Star]] can be a decent pick for loadouts which involve placing down one tower multiple times, even more so in higher player counts where players can place down less towers. **[[The Chariot]] is best ignored unless it is either the final wave or the two other options are far worse for your loadout, as it is a negative effect for every wave except the final one. **[[Temperance]], while it does provide every tower with stun immunity, is not that great of a pick as there are no enemies that stun until the final wave. It is however very useful on the final wave if given, as [[Mutation]] there will have no effect, meaning it comes with no downsides. ***Additionally, it gives a 20% reward boost, so if chosen later, it will not make it that much harder and give you extra rewards. **[[Death]] should be avoided as the only positive effect is a 20% reward boost, which is not worth it. ***If you want to beat this night with the [[Death]] curse, it is heavily advised to use either the [[Cowboy]] or [[Golden Cowboy]], and stall one [[Null Warden]] on wave 19 with either the [[Warden]] or [[Archer]] alongside the [[DJ Booth]]'s purple track ability so they can make money out of the [[Null Warden]] without doing damage to it, allowing you to afford high DPS towers for wave 20, or constantly using the [[Mercenary Base]]'s ''Airdrop'' ability to drop [[Riot Guard]]s. ****You may have to retry multiple times, as [[Death]] is not guaranteed to appear on wave 20 or even throughout the match. ****This also means you cannot pick [[The Sun]] beforehand, as this curse gives towers all detections, as well as giving all enemies the [[Stun Immunity]] attribute. ****[[The Tower]] is heavily recommended, as it increases the debuff duration from towers by 10%. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Null&VoidNight1PI.png|Current version on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NULLNVOIDNIGHT1THUMB.png|Current version on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Null&VoidNight1Hour12.png|'''Outpost 16''' on the game icon.
